blind.description: A square wooden trapdoor or hatch featuring vertical wooden planks on the lid reinforced by two horizontal wooden battens secured with metal rivets. One side has two sturdy iron hinges, while the front edge features a hinged iron pull ring. The lower wooden rim sits flush on the ground and is reinforced at the corners with riveted iron corner brackets. Surfaces are solid, clean, and stylized with hand-painted wood grain and metallic textures.
blind.from_above: A square wooden hatch seen directly from above, displaying parallel vertical planking bounded by horizontal wooden reinforcement slats with metal studs, two heavy iron hinges along the top edge, and an iron pull ring at the bottom center.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1 foot tall (less than one-fifth of the figure's height) and approximately 2.5 to 3 feet square.
